title: Spec 014 Durable Tenant Runtime Bridge Readiness

phases.objective: Define and validate the exact missing contracts between the verified SQL composition and the currently memory-owned synthetic Tenant canary before any runtime dependency injection or mount authorization.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Hostinger Storage Durable Tenant Runtime Bridge Readiness Guard
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: A provenance-bound packet reports whether every durable repository facade, parent orchestration, child translation, authority, enablement, projection, worker, fixed-dispatch, and restart requirement is complete while bridge creation, authorization, dependency injection, route mount, and provider dispatch remain false.
steps: Require the canonical verified SQL runtime composition in its unmounted state.
Bind readiness evidence to the same source SHA, deployed runtime SHA, database fingerprint, signed schema-verification digest, and readback cycle.
Bind the exact Tenant route path, dependency key, HTTP 503 default, Tenant JWT requirement, and current component versions.
Detect that the current Tenant canary is restricted to a factory-owned memory repository and that the synthetic executor still expects legacy child-write methods.
Require a canonical durable repository facade plus plan-item and run parent orchestration before child writes.

Require parent-aware Journal and Reconciliation translation, durable authority and enablement stores, Tenant-safe durable projection, certified worker/fixed dispatch, and crash-safe restart reconciliation.
Return ready_for_separate_mount_authorization only when all eleven capabilities pass.
Keep bridge_created, authorization_created, dependency_injected, runtime_mounted, route_mounted, worker_mounted, and provider_dispatch_allowed false.
assertions: The evaluator performs no database connection, database write, provider call, route mutation, server import, or worker registration.
Current memory-only canary and legacy executor contracts are detected from repository source rather than assumed.
Any missing capability produces a stable blocker code.
Runtime/database/schema/readback provenance mismatch, route drift, version drift, stale evidence, unsafe fields, semantic tampering, and digest tampering fail closed.
A passing packet is readiness for a separate authorization only and cannot create or mount a bridge.

phases.objective: Implement and separately authorize the durable Tenant runtime bridge after all eleven readiness capabilities have canonical evidence.
blockers: The canonical durable repository facade is not implemented.
Plan-item and run parent orchestration is not connected to the Tenant execution path.
Durable authority and enablement stores, worker certification, and crash-safe restart reconciliation are not complete.
No bridge mount authorization or runtime dependency injection has occurred.

phases.objective: Prove restart, stale authorization, partial parent creation, child replay, and dependency replacement behavior without duplicate write paths.
This readiness evaluator does not execute a live Tenant, database, worker, or provider canary.
Production mount and provider dispatch remain separately authorized and blocked.
